orderPolicy: Record randomized arm order for each case/repeat before execution; do not reuse sessions across arms or cases.
userResponsePolicy: Use only an applicable prewritten branch once, or record a real human response with source. Unexpected questions => human response or incomplete. Never let the evaluated model impersonate the user.
budgetPolicy: This plan authorizes no request. Use only an existing authorized host and enforce its confirmed cumulative request/token/cost/time caps before each request. Stop at cap; incomplete coverage stays incomplete. No retries outside the remaining approved cap.
reviewPolicy: All heldouts and critical cases require a human or independent reviewer using raw materials. Model self-evaluation is auxiliary only.
